S.FORM: O Afalian Lufic (Holam: 盧學叡;Ikilis: Afalean Lu; 1988 a miheca saka 2 a folad saka 15 a romi'ad－ saka) cecay mianingaya ato romadiw a tamdaw i Taywan. Taypak suli Nan'gang Kawcung a mico^yap, ca Ciyukok Unhwa Daigak sowal no France Bungak hi' ato Taypak suli Ondo Gaku'in a mico^yap. Na u micamol to malalifet Cawcisingkwangtataw i Pipahosoan to tilifi no Ciyukok .
S.PHON: o~u afaɾian ɾo~u~ufiʦ (ħo~uɾam: ***;ikiɾis: afaɾəan ɾo~u~u; **** a miħəʦa saka * a fo~uɾaɬ~ɮ saka ** a ro~umiʡaɬ~ɮ* saka) ʦəʦaj mianiŋaja ato~u ro~umaɬ~ɮiw a tamɬ~ɮaw i tajwan. tajpak so~u~uɾi nanʡ*aŋ kawʦo~u~uŋ a miʦo~uʔjap, ʦa ʦijo~u~uko~uk o~u~unħwa ɬ~ɮai*ak so~uwaɾ no~u franʦə b~b~vo~u~uŋak ħiʡ ato~u tajpak so~u~uɾi o~unɬ~ɮo~u *ako~u~uʡin a miʦo~uʔjap. na o~u~u miʦamo~uɾ to~u maɾaɾifət ʦawʦisiŋkwaŋtataw i pipaħo~uso~uan to~u tiɾifi no~u ʦijo~u~uko~uk .
